regions.full_page: With no further trouble that night I slept well, and next morning at the first douche of water on my face, there was like a bubble broke in my bad ear and I thought: "Thank God! My drum is not broken". Be- fore 24 hours my hearing was perfect; and, what is further notable, I've had practically no trouble with my hearing ever since. Thanks be to God and His little spouse, now Saint Therese "The Little Flower. I have read her book fifteen times since thet and have had at least that many favors. The above will give you an idea of how I would advise you if you still hope for a vocation. Praying for vocation, if not a poitive vo- cation in itself, is surely an essential and outstanding feature in the character of every ideal Christian as well as in every practical missionary. Think it over, Encourage, foster vocations. Wherever we may be or whatever our state in life, we may in many ways become in- struments of the Holy Spirit by praying for and promoting vocations. Now, as to your "big problem"; as well as the minor interests to which you refer. I think you ought to be able to find a practical solu- tion in the above, as primarily intended for your own personal guidance. I am inclined to congratulate you on your place of imployment, Mt Olivet Cemetery; and on your privileged cornection with the boys of Holy Name Parish. It was a privilege of mine to be assistant in that dear parish twenty-five years ago and chaplain at the - then - comparatively new but leading cemetery.
